name: 57580 · Winner, SD
findings: ZIP 57580 (Winner) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 57580 (Winner) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 57580 (Winner) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.1 times the typical level).
